agorapulse.name: Agorapulse
agorapulse.tagline: Social inbox, scheduling and reporting for enterprises and agencies
agorapulse.desc: Agorapulse is a social media management platform built for agencies, brands, and social teams that pairs a unified inbox with scheduling, listening and reporting.
agorapulse.best: Agencies and enterprises managing multiple accounts.
features: Track and respond to all your social media interactions in one centralized Inbox
Plan and schedule your social media content across all platforms with an intuitive post scheduler and shared calendars
Monitor and track mentions of your brand, industry, and competitors by capturing conversations from social networks
Make better business decisions with actionable social media reports that don’t take all day to create

pricingTiers.name: Standard
pricingTiers.description: Built for social media managers handling it all themselves
features: 1 user, 10 profiles, unified inbox, scheduling, basic reports

pricingTiers.name: Professional
pricingTiers.description: Perfect for growing teams who need to move faster together
features: 1 user, 10 profiles, advanced inbox, scheduling, enhanced reports

pricingTiers.name: Advanced
pricingTiers.description: Ideal for enterprise teams needing structure and deeper insights
features: 1 user, 10 profiles, premium inbox, scheduling, comprehensive reports

audiense.name: Audiense
audiense.tagline: Audience intelligence and segmentation for X marketers.
audiense.desc: Audiense builds rich audience segments from X data by capturing interests, influencers and personas, so brands can understand exactly who follows them and why.
audiense.best: Marketers, researchers and agencies doing audience research.
features: Advanced Segmentation: Breaks down massive global profiles into distinct, actionable sub-communities based on shared affinities or digital connections
Psychographic & Personality Insights: Evaluates mindset, values, and personality traits to explain what truly motivates an audience.
Media & Channel Affinities: Identifies the specific publications, digital channels, and influencers your target consumers follow, optimizing ad placement and budget allocation
Seamless Integrations: Connects directly with CRM systems, advertising channels, and data warehouses to turn insights into immediate targeting actions

pricingTiers.name: Custom Tier
pricingTiers.description: Audience Insights and Connect (the original X Marketing plan) features are now retired and are available under Audience Discover with enterprise plans and a free trial.

detail.pricingNote: Original Twitter Marketing plan for 39$ per month is no longer available

autopublix.name: AutoPubliX
autopublix.tagline: Set up automated DM replies on X in minutes.
autopublix.desc: AutoPubliX makes DM automation beginner-friendly, connect your account and launch auto-reply and welcome flows without a learning curve.
autopublix.best: Creators, marketers and agencies seeking quick DM setup at affordable prices.
features: Quick DM automation setup
Auto-reply templates
Welcome messages
Simple dashboard

pricingTiers.name: Free
pricingTiers.description: 1 X account with 3000 DMs per month

pricingTiers.name: Creator
pricingTiers.description: 3 X accounts with upto 5000 DMs per month

pricingTiers.name: Growth Plan
pricingTiers.description: 5 X accounts with unlimited DMs per month

beacons.name: Beacons
beacons.tagline: A link-in-bio that doubles as a creator store.
beacons.desc: Beacons combines a link-in-bio page with a store, email tools and a media kit so creators can sell straight from their X bio.
beacons.best: Creators who want to grow their audience and sell from their bio.
features: Build your presence - Create a link in bio page so distinctly yours that every follower and brand partner finds exactly what they need, in seconds
Monetize your work - Sell merch, digital products,   and courses directly from your Beacons link in bio page.
Land your dream partnership - Get discovered by brands by pitching with an auto-updating media kit
Own your audience - Send newsletters to your community, automate your DMs, and track exactly what’s working

pricingTiers.name: Creator
pricingTiers.description: Claim your brand with a custom domain & website, 0 transaction fees when you sell, advanced analytics & enhanced customizations

pricingTiers.name: Creator Plus
pricingTiers.description: Drive big sales and partnerships by having priority support, team access, advanced integrations + All Creator features

pricingTiers.name: Creator Max
pricingTiers.description: Grow unlimited as a creator & influencer - sell unlimited courses, sessions, priority access to Beacons IRL events

detail.pricingNote: Fantastic value for the features it offers (link-in-bio, analytics, commerce)

beautifythis.name: Beautify This
beautifythis.tagline: Make your posts look stunning with one-click styling.
beautifythis.desc: Beautify This transforms plain Twitter posts (tweets) into eye-catching, shareable graphics with templates and backgrounds without any design skills needed.
beautifythis.best: Content creators who want quick, good-looking visuals.
features: One-click beautify for all your twitter posts
Customization options while editing
Background and gradient library
Completely free tool with bot feature

biolink.name: Bio.link
biolink.tagline: A fast, simple hosted bio-link page.
biolink.desc: Bio.link offers a clean, quick-to-set-up bio page to add your links, share posts, send emails, and let AI greet and guide your visitors
biolink.best: Creators and brands wanting simple, no-fuss bio hosting.
features: Quick bio page setup
Unlimited links
Basic analytics
Free trial plan

pricingTiers.name: Pro Plan
pricingTiers.description: Single premium pro plan with a free trial of 7 days. No free plans at all.
features: Unlimited sites & Unlimited visitors
AI Chat doubles engagement by visitors
Use your own custom domain, with zero branding
Publish posts and build email list

birdy.name: Birdy.so
birdy.tagline: A/B test your bio and profile to convert more followers for your X profile.
birdy.desc: Birdy helps creators experiment with bios, pinned posts and profile setups, measuring which variations turn visitors into followers.
features: Bio A/B testing
Profile conversion tracking
Pinned-post experiments
Visitor insights

detail.pricingNote: Birdy is now integrated with Typefully and is closed for new users!
